suggested_requirements.text: The product shall plot data points in a scientifically correct manner.
The product shall label the grid axis according to the input from the data file.
The product shall colour data points in accordance with the cluster number contained in the data file.
The product shall handle up to 2000 data points.
The product shall display the name of a data point upon a single mouse click over the point.
The product shall display all details of a data point upon a double-click of the mouse over the point.
The product shall allow the user to select multiple points to display multiple names.
The product shall allow the user to rotate, zoom, and move the grid.
The product shall be available on both Windows and Linux operating platforms.
The execution of the application shall be kept on the server side.
The product shall run on a minimum of a mid-range personal computer.
The product shall run with the minimum input tools of mouse and keyboard.
The user must have a capability for creating tab-delimited text files.
The application shall be coloured to allow clear printing on a white background.
The application shall be intuitive and not require specialist training.
The program shall start within 30 seconds.
The interaction with data points shall have a delay of no longer than 2 seconds.
The response to a change in orientation shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought.
